G-Research | London, UK | On-site | https://www.gresearch.com/

We’re a quantitative research and technology firm bringing together world-class researchers and engineers to tackle complex problems in financial markets.

Our engineers play a central role, building the systems and platforms that turn research into production and enable large-scale experimentation.
